eval_name: Establish base, branch, and detached-HEAD handling
prompt:
I want a worktree to implement feature X. What base should I use, should I
assume main is the integration target, and how should I handle the task branch
versus a disposable inspection checkout?
assertions: output_contains.any: [do not assume starting commit task branch detached]
output_contains.any: [detached HEAD detached anchor checkout protection checked out elsewhere]
